intent: Trace the percentage of Americans supporting replacement of the Electoral College from 1965 through 2015 and determine whether it stayed above the majority level throughout.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Trace the percentage supporting replacement of the Electoral College across the full plotted series, including unlabeled turns, from 1965 through the final plotted point.
Did support remain above 50% at every plotted point, including unlabeled points?
